Return only one JSON call inside <tool_call></tool_call> tags, with tool_name set to one enum value. After that call, you will receive a <tool_response> containing the selected real tool schema. Then call that real tool exactly once for the original user request, using its exact function name and parameter keys. Your second assistant turn must have exactly this complete form, not a bare arguments object: <tool_call>
{"name":"<selected real name>","arguments":{...}}
</tool_call>. Do not repeat the meta-tool after the tool response and do not emit prose.

This conversation uses two-stage tool calling. First, call exactly the meta-tool below; do not call a real tool before the tool response arrives. Return only one JSON call inside <tool_call></tool_call> tags, with tool_name set to one enum value. After that call, you will receive a <tool_response> containing the selected real tool schema. Then call that real tool exactly once for the original user request, using its exact function name and parameter keys. Your second assistant turn must have exactly this complete form, not a bare arguments object: <tool_call>
{"name":"<selected real name>","arguments":{...}}
</tool_call>. Do not repeat the meta-tool after the tool response and do not emit prose.

Meta-tool schema:
{
  "type": "function",
  "function": {
    "name": "select_tool",
    "description": "Choose the one real tool that should handle the query.",
    "parameters": {
      "type": "object",
      "properties": {
        "tool_name": {
          "type": "string",
          "enum": [
            "v1_category",
            "leagues",
            "exchange_currency",
            "usd_egp",
            "get_list_of_news",
            "cota_o.exibe_cota_o",
            "extract_content",

            "api_info",
            "get_data",

            "convert_from_one_unit_to_another",
            "retorna_os_registros_dos_ltimos_dias",
            "getrandomword",
            "type_performance_get_trailing_returns",
            "temperature_from_to_number",
            "popular_rates",
            "exchange_rate_risk_specific_base_currency",
            "converter",
            "cny_rates"
          ]
        }
      },
      "required": [
        "tool_name"
      ],
      "additionalProperties": false
    }
  }
}

functions.name: v1_mortgagecalculator
functions.description: Calculates monthly mortgage payments and related financial metrics based on loan parameters and property details. Users must provide either the loan_amount or a combination of home_value and downpayment. Returns calculated payment amounts, interest costs, and other relevant financial data. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

interest_rate.description: Annual interest rate in percentage (e.g., 3.5 for 3.5%). Must not exceed 10000.

downpayment.description: Upfront payment toward the property purchase, in USD. Must be less than home_value if provided.

home_value.description: Total property value, in USD. Must exceed downpayment amount if provided.

monthly_hoa.description: Monthly homeowner association fees, in USD.

annual_property_tax.description: Annual property tax liability, in USD. Must be a numeric string value.

duration_years.description: Loan term in years. Valid range: 1-10000. Defaults to 30 years if not specified.

loan_amount.description: Principal loan amount. Required if home_value and downpayment are not provided.

annual_home_insurance.description: Annual homeowner's insurance premium, in USD.

parameters.description: Mortgage calculator parameters. Either loan_amount OR both home_value and downpayment must be provided.

Return only one JSON call inside <tool_call></tool_call> tags, with tool_name set to one enum value. After that call, you will receive a <tool_response> containing the selected real tool schema. Then call that real tool exactly once for the original user request, using its exact function name and parameter keys. Your second assistant turn must have exactly this complete form, not a bare arguments object: <tool_call>
{"name":"<selected real name>","arguments":{...}}
</tool_call>. Do not repeat the meta-tool after the tool response and do not emit prose.
